children: A whale or institution bought 396,811 HYPE through multiple centralized exchanges over the past three days, spending about $29.29 million, and transferred all the tokens to staking six hours ago. According to Odaily, chain analyst Ember monitored the purchases after HYPE fell about 26% this month, from $96 to $71.

title: Whale or Institution Buys Nearly 397,000 HYPE Through Multiple CEXs in Three Days and Stakes All
